movelist.name: Lucky Chant
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Lucky Chant may activate it when receiving a Critical Hit to cause the attack to instead deal damage as if it was not a Critical Hit. Lucky Chant may be activated 3 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Moonlight
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value. If it is Sunny, the user gains 2/3 of its full Hit Point value. If it is Rainy, Sand Storming or Hailing the user gains 1/4 of their full Hit Point value.

movelist.name: Imprison
movelist.effect: The target is Locked for the rest of the Scene. A Locked target may not use any Moves the user knows. Imprison cannot miss.

movelist.name: Yawn
movelist.effect: The target falls Asleep at the end of their next turn. Yawn cannot miss.

abilities.name: Telepathy
abilities.effect: The user gains +1 Evasion. Whenever an Ally uses a damaging area-of-effect attack that would hit you, you may Disengage as a Free Action before the attack resolves.
